new_description:
## Problem

When `jloop-build` finishes and opens the PR, the Linear issue keeps the `approved` label and shows no visible signal that a solution is ready. The human (merge gate) has to leave Linear and hunt for the PR to know work is done and awaiting merge. There is no distinct workflow state for "built, PR open, awaiting human merge" — so completed-but-unmerged issues look indistinguishable from ones still being built.

**✅ Solution Ready For Merge**
[https://github.com/GenXsirAI/jloop/pull/4](https://github.com/GenXsirAI/jloop/pull/4)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — A new closed-vocabulary state label `waiting-to-merge` exists on the `Gold Medal Equity` team (created if absent). The full state machine becomes exactly four labels: `spec-waiting-approval` → `approved` → `waiting-to-merge` → `completed`.
- [ ] **AC-2** — At the end of a successful `jloop-build` pass, immediately after the PR is opened, the build **swaps** the state label: removes `approved`, adds `waiting-to-merge`. Only ONE state label is present on the issue at a time. Non-state labels (`Feature`, `Improvement`, `Bug`) are untouched.
- [ ] **AC-3** — In the same step, the build edits the Linear issue description to insert a callout block on its own line **immediately below the** `## Problem` **section** (before `## Acceptance Criteria`), reading exactly: `**✅ Solution Ready For Merge**` followed by a markdown link to the open PR URL. The callout is clickable and resolves to the PR.
- [ ] **AC-4** — Idempotent: re-running the build / retries do NOT duplicate the callout block or stack multiple `waiting-to-merge` labels. If a callout already exists it is updated in place (PR URL refreshed), not appended again. Keyed on `merge-signal:<issue>`.
- [ ] **AC-5** — On human merge / move to Done, the `waiting-to-merge` label is shed and `completed` applied (consistent with the existing "completed issues shed pipeline labels" rule). The callout may remain as an artifact or be stripped — implementer's choice, documented.
- [ ] **AC-6** — `jloop-build`, `jloop-review`, `jloop-spec`, and `agentic-build-loop` skill docs are updated to reflect the four-label state machine and the new post-PR signalling step.

## Non-goals

* **NG-1** — Agents still NEVER merge. `waiting-to-merge` is a signal, not authorization; the human merges. No auto-merge added.
* **NG-2** — No change to scope verification, lease, or idempotency-core internals beyond adding the new `merge-signal:<issue>` key usage (reuse, don't fork).
* **NG-3** — Do not alter the `spec-waiting-approval` / `approved` / `completed` semantics or who sets them (`approved`/`completed` remain human-only).
* **NG-4** — No new Linear connector/tooling; use existing issue-update + label capabilities and `LINEAR_API_KEY`.
* **NG-5** — The callout placement is strictly below `## Problem`; do not restructure the rest of the issue body.

## Relevant files

* `scripts/*` (jloop build finalize step) — apply label swap + description callout after PR create.
* `~/.hermes/skills/jloop-build/SKILL.md` — document the new close-out step.
* `~/.hermes/skills/jloop-review/SKILL.md` — reflect the `waiting-to-merge` state.
* `~/.hermes/skills/jloop-spec/SKILL.md` — update the closed-vocabulary rule (3 → 4 labels).
* `~/.hermes/skills/software-development/agentic-build-loop/SKILL.md` — update the loop diagram + rules.
* `.factory/contracts/<ISSUE>.yaml` — this issue's contract.

## Test expectations

* Label swap: after PR open, issue has `waiting-to-merge`, not `approved`; other labels preserved.
* Callout: description contains the `**✅ Solution Ready For Merge**` block with a working PR link, positioned directly after `## Problem`.
* Idempotency: second finalize run → single callout, single `waiting-to-merge` label.
* Merge/Done: `waiting-to-merge` removed, `completed` added.

## How to verify

1. Run a build to PR-open on a test issue → confirm label is `waiting-to-merge` (approved gone).
2. Open the Linear issue → callout appears right under `## Problem`, links to the PR.
3. Re-run finalize → no duplicate callout, no stacked labels.
4. Merge the PR / move to Done → label becomes `completed`.
5. Read the four updated skills → they describe the four-state machine.

**Risk:** medium (touches Linear writes + build finalize + four skill docs).
